sentences.text: Chile , is a South American country occupying a long , narrow strip of land between the Andes to the east and the Pacific Ocean to the west .	Andes	Andes
It borders Peru to the north , Bolivia to the northeast , Argentina to the east , and the Drake Passage in the far south .	Peru	Peru	Bolivia	Bolivia	Argentina	Argentina	Drake Passage	Drake Passage

Chilean territory includes the Pacific islands of Juan Fernández , Salas y Gómez , Desventuradas , and Easter Island in Oceania .	Juan Fernández	Juan Fernández Islands	Salas y Gómez	Salas y Gómez	Desventuradas	Desventuradas Islands	Easter Island	Easter Island	Oceania	Oceania
Chile also claims about 1250000 km2 of Antarctica , although all claims are suspended under the Antarctic Treaty .	Antarctica	Antarctica	Antarctic Treaty	Antarctic Treaty
The arid Atacama Desert in northern Chile contains great mineral wealth , principally copper .	Atacama Desert	Atacama Desert	copper	Copper#Production

The relatively small central area dominates in terms of population and agricultural resources , and is the cultural and political center from which Chile expanded in the late 19th century when it incorporated its northern and southern regions .
Southern Chile is rich in forests and grazing lands , and features a string of volcanoes and lakes .
The southern coast is a labyrinth of fjords , inlets , canals , twisting peninsulas , and islands .

Spain conquered and colonized Chile in the mid-16th century , replacing Inca rule in northern and central Chile , but failing to conquer the independent Mapuche who inhabited south-central Chile .	Mapuche	Mapuche	Spain	Spain	Spain conquered and colonized	Conquest of Chile	Inca rule	Incas in Central Chile	failing to conquer	Arauco War

After declaring its independence from Spain in 1818 , Chile emerged in the 1830s as a relatively stable authoritarian republic .	Spain	Spain	declaring its independence	Chilean Declaration of Independence

In the 19th century , Chile saw significant economic and territorial growth , ending Mapuche resistance in the 1880s and gaining its current northern territory in the War of the Pacific -LRB- 1879 -- 83 -RRB- after defeating Peru and Bolivia .	Mapuche	Mapuche	Peru	Peru	Bolivia	Bolivia	ending Mapuche resistance	Occupation of Araucanía	War of the Pacific	War of the Pacific
In the 1960s and 1970s the country experienced severe left-right political polarization and turmoil .	political polarization	Polarization (politics)

This development culminated with the 1973 Chilean coup d'état that overthrew Salvador Allende 's democratically elected left-wing government and instituted a 16-year-long right-wing military dictatorship that left more than 3,000 people dead or missing .	1973 Chilean coup d'état	1973 Chilean coup d'état	Salvador Allende	Salvador Allende	a 16-year-long right-wing military dictatorship	Military dictatorship of Chile (1973–90)

The regime , headed by Augusto Pinochet , ended in 1990 after it lost a referendum in 1988 and was succeeded by a center-left coalition which ruled through four presidencies until 2010 .	Augusto Pinochet	Augusto Pinochet	referendum in 1988	Chilean presidential referendum, 1988	center-left coalition	Concertación
Chile is today one of South America 's most stable and prosperous nations .	South America	South America

It leads Latin American nations in rankings of human development , competitiveness , income per capita , globalization , state of peace , economic freedom , and low perception of corruption .	human development	human development (humanity)	competitiveness	competitiveness	income per capita	income per capita	globalization	globalization	state of peace	Global Peace Index	economic freedom	economic freedom	low perception of corruption	Political corruption
It also ranks high regionally in sustainability of the state , and democratic development .	sustainability of the state	Failed States Index#Failed States Index

Chile is a founding member of the United Nations , the Union of South American Nations -LRB- UNASUR -RRB- and the Community of Latin American and Caribbean States -LRB- CELAC -RRB- .
